title: Tor-independence for monoid-ideal quotients in a log regular chart
statement: Let $(X,M,\alpha)$ be a locally Noetherian log regular fs log scheme [def-trf-fs-log-blowup, pqf-def-locnoeth], let $\bar x$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], let $A=\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{X,\bar x}$ be its strict henselization [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], and let $P=\overline M_{\bar x}$ be identified with a chart monoid whose structural map is $a:P\to A$. A monoid ideal means a subset $I\subseteq P$ with $I+P\subseteq I$. For every monoid ideal $I$, writing $R=\mathbf Z[P]$, $IR$ for the ideal of $R$ generated by the monomials from $I$, and letting $R\to A$ be induced by $a$, one has\n$$\operatorname{Tor}^{R}_1(R/IR,A)=0.$$

source.place: Expose VIII, Lemma 3.4.3 proof, invoking Kato (1994), 6.1(ii), for Tor-independence of monoid-ideal quotients with the structure ring.

mathlib_searches.query: For a log regular fine saturated chart P mapping to a strict henselian local ring A, Tor one over Z[P] of Z[P] modulo a monoid ideal with A vanishes.
Kato log regular Tor independence: Tor_1 over the monoid algebra of a monoid ideal quotient and the structure ring is zero.

from.place: Proof (1)--(2) of lem-trf-local-term-locality: Exposé VIII, Lemma 3.4.3 invokes Kato, 1994, 6.1(ii) for Tor-independence of chart monoid-ideal quotients with the structure ring.
